topic: Silicon Valley Bank collapse and FDIC closure in March 2023

fact_checks.description: SVB's closure is anchored to March 10, 2023
matching_facts: On Friday, March 10, 2023, Silicon Valley Bank, Santa Clara, CA was closed by the California Department of Financial Protection & Innovation and the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) was named Receiver.

matching_facts: When economic problems hit the tech sector, many bank customers withdrew money as venture capital started drying up.

SVB had heavily invested deposits into long-term treasury bonds, which lost value as the Federal Reserve raised interest rates. Consequently, the bank was unable to meet withdrawal demands, leading to significant losses when it had to sell these bonds at unfavorable prices.
